content:
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
Backend Software Engineer

daniel.okafor-reyes@example.com | +351 555 010 202
linkedin.com/in/daniel-okafor-reyes-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 7+ years of experience building Java and Spring services for insurance and travel products. Experienced in REST API design, PostgreSQL and Oracle, Kafka event processing, automated testing, and AWS cloud deployment. Improved API performance and production reliability, and participates in on-call incident response. Interested in moving to a Python stack; Python experience is currently limited to scripts and Jenkins helpers.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Java 8–17, Kotlin (basic), Python (scripting), Go (learning; personal project)
Backend and APIs: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, REST, OpenAPI
Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ
Cloud and delivery: AWS (EKS, S3, SQS), Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Jenkins, Git, Linux
Testing: JUnit 5, Testcontainers, Spring Cloud Contract

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Backend Engineer | Tejo Insurance Tech | Jan 2022–Present
- Develop and maintain seven Java 17 and Spring Boot microservices for policy quoting and claims intake.
- Designed a versioned REST API using OpenAPI 3 for 12 broker partners. Added partner-specific rate limiting and contract tests; the API handles around 400,000 quote requests per month.
- Reduced quote endpoint p99 latency from 1.8 seconds to 450 ms using Redis caching and by fixing N+1 JPA queries.
- Implemented a transactional outbox and idempotent Kafka consumers, reducing duplicate claims from approximately 40 per week to zero over the following quarter.
- Built a Kotlin and Spring Boot document service for policy PDFs using AWS S3 and SQS, and wrote the team's Kotlin coding guidelines.
- Deploy services to Kubernetes on AWS EKS using Helm and Jenkins pipelines. Participate in on-call one week per month; handled and documented a Kafka lag incident in March 2024.
- Facilitate the backend guild meeting every two weeks, and work in English across the team.

Software Developer | Viajar Online S.A. | Sep 2019–Dec 2021
- Built booking and payment features in a Java 11 and Spring MVC monolith backed by Oracle.
- Used Testcontainers for integration tests, increasing payments module coverage from 35% to 70% and supporting safer refactoring.
- Extracted email and SMS notifications into a separate Spring Boot service using RabbitMQ, Oracle and Docker.

Junior Developer, internship then full-time | CodeFarol Lda | Jul 2018–Aug 2019
- Maintained PHP and Java applications for small business clients.

EDUCATION
BSc Informatics Engineering | Atlantic Polytechnic Institute | 2018

CERTIFICATION
Oracle Certified Professional Java SE 11 Developer | 2020

PERSONAL PROJECT
OpenAPI specification diff CLI | Go
- Building a personal command-line project to compare OpenAPI specifications; approximately 600 lines, not used in production.

LANGUAGES
English: fluent | Portuguese: fluent | Spanish: conversational

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, clear, professionally structured CV with a concise summary, logical section headings, relevant technical skills, and quantified achievements. The experience bullets demonstrate meaningful backend ownership, performance improvement, reliability work, event-driven architecture, testing, cloud deployment, and on-call support. The document is also commendably transparent about limited Python experience rather than overstating it. The main content limitation is that Python is not yet a production skill, so the CV must rely on the comparable-language pathway in the advertisement. A few bullets could make CI/CD, automated testing, database query tuning, and technical communication even more explicit.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV is highly ATS-compatible: it uses standard headings, plain text, conventional employment formatting, searchable technology names, and no tables, graphics, columns, or unusual symbols that would hinder parsing. It contains strong matches for Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, REST, OpenAPI, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redis, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Jenkins, JUnit, Testcontainers, and CI/CD-related work. AI screening probability is high for the comparable-language route and moderate overall because the target role is Python-focused and the CV explicitly states that Python experience is limited to scripting. Adding the exact supported terms "CI/CD," "automated testing," "query tuning," and "cloud deployment" would improve keyword alignment without overstating experience.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV aligns well with the comparable-language requirement through more than seven years of Java backend development and additional Kotlin experience. It also strongly matches REST API design, relational databases, query performance improvement, Docker, AWS cloud deployment, automated testing, Jenkins delivery pipelines, Kafka, Kubernetes/EKS, production incident response, and fluent English. The quantified API scale and latency improvement are particularly relevant to the tracking API and reliability focus of the role. The CV also supports the company's ownership and continuous-improvement culture through on-call participation, incident documentation, coding guidelines, backend guild facilitation, and measurable reliability improvements. Gaps are professional Python service development, demonstrated schema migrations, Terraform implementation, observability tooling, logistics or EDI experience, and Dutch or French. The document appropriately does not claim these capabilities.
critique.improvement_instructions:
Minor enhancements only:
1. In the Technical Skills section under "Cloud and delivery," change the wording to "Cloud and delivery: AWS (EKS, S3, SQS), Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, Git, Linux". Jenkins pipelines are directly supported by the Tejo Insurance Tech experience, and adding the exact term "CI/CD" will improve ATS matching.
2. In the Technical Skills section under "Testing," change the heading or content to "Automated testing: JUnit 5, Testcontainers, Spring Cloud Contract". This uses the job advertisement's exact terminology while remaining fully supported.
3. In the Professional Summary, change "Experienced in REST API design, PostgreSQL and Oracle, Kafka event processing, automated testing, and AWS cloud deployment" to "Experienced in REST API design, PostgreSQL and Oracle, relational database query tuning, Kafka event processing, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS cloud deployment." The added terms are supported by the Redis/JPA performance work, Jenkins deployments, and AWS/EKS experience.
4. In the Tejo Insurance Tech experience section, revise "Reduced quote endpoint p99 latency from 1.8 seconds to 450 ms using Redis caching and by fixing N+1 JPA queries" to "Improved quote API performance by reducing p99 latency from 1.8 seconds to 450 ms through Redis caching and relational database query tuning to eliminate N+1 JPA queries." This more directly matches the advertisement's performance and query-tuning language without claiming schema-migration experience.
5. In the Tejo Insurance Tech experience section, revise "Deploy services to Kubernetes on AWS EKS using Helm and Jenkins pipelines" to "Deploy services to Kubernetes on AWS EKS using Helm and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines." This makes the existing delivery experience easier for ATS and recruiters to identify.
